name: Cyberpunk Neon
tagline: Rain-slick streets, holograms and electric color.
description: Step into a futuristic megacity: neon alleys in the rain, holographic night markets, rooftop helipads with flying traffic, noodle stalls, server rooms and synthwave highways. Techwear, glowing trims and magenta-cyan light, shot like a sci-fi film.
